services.desc: Step inside the imagination of award-winning graphic novelist John Jennings, and see where Mississippi mythology, ancestral spirits, and visionary science fiction come to life. John Jennings: Build Your World, an immersive new experience at The MAX in downtown Meridian, showcases the extraordinary work of the Flora, Mississippi native and New York Times bestselling, award-winning graphic novelist. In Build Your World, Jennings’s groundbreaking work in Afrofuturism, folklore, and comics is brought to life through multiple creative projects, including Silver Surfer: Ghost Light (Marvel), Kenny Dreadful and the Hainted Hoodie, Blue Hand Mojo: Hard Times Road (Rosarium Publishing), and Kindred:
